decks.notes: The Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay by using low-cost creatures and spells to quickly chip away at your opponent's life total. With a strong emphasis on red and white creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt, Goblin Bombardment, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help maintain pressure on the opponent while cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide a powerful late-game threat.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively hitting the opponent with a mix of creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to control the board with cards like Static Prison and Lightning Bolt while also utilizing creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage. The deck also includes Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional aggression and reach. With the support of cards like Guide of Souls and Ocelot Pride, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced offense.

The deck revolves around using Birthing Ritual to ramp up mana quickly and utilizing Collected Company to search for and put creatures onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to assemble a toolbox of creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide, Samwise Gamgee, and Overlord of the Balemurk to create powerful combos and overwhelm the opponent. Viscera Seer and Cauldron Familiar help with sacrificing and recurring creatures for additional value. Ruthless Lawbringer and Gilded Goose provide additional utility and support. Overall, the deck aims to be versatile and adaptive, utilizing a variety of creatures for different situations.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful combo without needing to rely on lands, utilizing cards that manipulate the top of the library and create mana sources. By carefully sequencing spells and possibly countering opponent's plays, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a game-winning combo using cards like Flare of Denial and Goblin Charbelcher. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells to control the game state while setting up the combo. With a fast and efficient strategy, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can react effectively.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells, supported by powerful enchantments like Static Prison and Arena of Glory. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional consistency and versatility. With a mix of efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with strong removal options in Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge, this deck aims to apply relentless pressure and finish games before opponents have a chance to stabilize. The addition of The One Ring offers a potent late-game threat to close out matches.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast-paced strategy that aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key concept is to quickly build a board presence with cards like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, while also using burn spells like Lightning Bolt to clear the way for attacks. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory help to boost the efficiency and strength of your creatures, while cards like Goblin Bombardment offer additional reach for direct damage. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to close out the game quickly and decisively.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mixture of aggressive creatures and burn spells. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls provide support and pump up your creatures, while Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment can help finish off your opponent quickly. The deck also includes cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison to control the board and keep your opponent on the back foot. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck looks to close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt opponents with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus. The deck aims to control the game by countering key spells, removing threats, and disrupting card advantage through abilities like Thought Scour. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergy with Unearth and considers to maintain a resource advantage. Additionally, the deck includes lands like Watery Grave and Polluted Delta to ensure consistent mana production.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and creature removal. By manipulating the opponent's hand with spells like Thoughtseize and Siphon Insight, countering their spells with cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation, and removing their threats with Fatal Push and other removal spells, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a blend of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. Utilizing cards like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Orcish Bowmasters, it aims to deal quick damage while controlling the opponent's board with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble provide additional value and card advantage. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion option to enhance the deck's efficiency. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply pressure early on while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption to overwhelm opponents. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Tarfire, alongside powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Mishra's Bauble helps with card selection, while cards like Detective's Phoenix and Omnivorous Flytrap provide additional value. The mana base is designed to support a quick start, with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure from the start and maintain it throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of spells and abilities to win the game without using any lands. The key strategy involves using cards like Sea Gate Restoration, Lotus Bloom, and Goblin Charbelcher to quickly generate and manipulate mana, while also disrupting opponents with counterspells like Disrupting Shoal and Flare of Denial. The win condition is typically achieved by either casting Thassa's Oracle or Jace, Wielder of Mysteries to draw out the entire deck and win the game on the spot. This deck aims to be fast and efficient in executing its combos to overwhelm the opponent.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal, and graveyard manipulation. By using cards like Counterspell, Fatal Push, and Drown in the Loch, it can control the board and protect its own threats. Thought Scour and Unearth allow for graveyard synergies, while Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus provide powerful finishers. The deck also includes some hand disruption with Sink into Stupor and Surgical Extraction. The goal is to out-value the opponent and control the game until victory is secured.

This deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments. Utilizing cards like Amped Raptor, Ocelot Pride, and Guide of Souls, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. With support from disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Static Prison, the opponent's game plan can be easily disrupted, allowing for a smooth path to victory. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility to the deck, ensuring a well-rounded and powerful strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive play, utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge for direct damage. The deck also includes creatures like Guide of Souls and Amped Raptor to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of The One Ring and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional support and buffs for the creatures in the deck. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage and powerful creatures, while also providing some control elements with cards like Static Prison.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with creatures like Amped Raptor and Bonecrusher Giant, supported by burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah boosts the deck's ability to pressure opponents. Additionally, the use of cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison helps to control the board and maintain momentum. The deck also features a unique win condition with the inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, providing a versatile and dynamic playstyle.
